clockBasis: Conservative resumption mark before the first recorded clock read; prior user/review waiting excluded.
userInstruction: Go, with a hard stop after two authoring days if the radiating boundary or branch-endpoint integration needs a larger method project. Scope: one case (LAB_HELD/RHO4), saved k_parallel, omega=3 plus one frequency just above the bulk threshold and one higher. Report transverse energy balance, zero-contrast control, contrast scaling, domain/regulator sensitivity and negative-deficit flag. Two independent reviews for boundary/integration; none for pure tooling fixes; stop with results.
authorityInterpretation: User resumes bounded correction and independent method review toward the same numerical goal. toolingPolicy: Pure loader/format/comparison repairs use local tests and rationale; changes to equations, methods or claims require independent review.
